Icon Glyph Reference.

Every Lucide glyph currently wired into the add-on’s UI, rendered from the exact font file the app ships (lucide-icons.ttf) — plus the full 2,027-icon catalog below it to browse for a better-matching replacement. Click any catalog tile to copy its codepoint.

02 Full Lucide catalog

from lucide-icons.ttf — the bundled font already has every one of these, no new asset needed to swap
 
No icon matches that search.

Wiring a replacement: copy the hex codepoint from a catalog tile, set it as the new value in icon_glyphs.py, then use it either as &#x{CODEPOINT:04X}; inside a static skin XML <label>, or chr(icon_glyphs.NAME) when setting a ListItem/Window property from Python. A <label> showing a glyph needs <width>/<height> ≥ the icon font’s own point size or Kodi renders a solid dot instead of the glyph. Then re-run python3 tools/gen_icon_reference.py so this page catches up.

Source of truth for the full catalog: tools/lucide_font_src/codepoints.json (dev reference, not shipped with the add-on). Font license: ISC (Lucide) / MIT (icons derived from Feather) — see resources/skins/Main/media/LUCIDE_LICENSE.txt.
